paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: The figure is a nested (donut) pie chart showing the distribution of samples across two ambiguity-related measures, with the outer ring representing “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and the inner ring representing “Max Ambiguity (Inner).” There are 4 slices in the outer ring: “Std: 0.0” (dark charcoal) at about 49.0%, “Std: 0.47” (dark gray) at about 39.0%, “Std: 0.82” (medium gray) at about 5.0%, and “Std: 0.94” (light gray) at about 7.0%, with percentage labels placed on the ring. The inner ring has 3 slices: “Max: 1” (medium-light gray) at about 47.7%, “Max: 2” (lighter gray) at about 38.0%, and “Max: 3” (very light gray) at about 14.2%, also labeled with percentages on the slices. Two legends appear on the right, one for the outer ring categories and one for the inner ring categories; no slices are exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segment arrangement appears to follow the circular order rather than a clearly descending sequence.
